{{Top|leg}}
'''Rojos''' were a type of [[Flower/Legends|flower]]. They went well in a bouquet composed of [[Everlily|everlilies]], [[Blueblossom/Legends|blueblossoms]] and [[purple passion]]s. Although, such an arrangement was reasonably expensive, at a cost equivalent to several days pay of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Naval]] officer's salary.

[[Teela Kaarz]] received such a bouquet while being courted by [[Villian Dance]] on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].
